snippet.title: Rodent Rumble Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Assemble your squad and mark your territory in Rodent Rumble! Level up, scavenge, and scrap with other rodents in a chaotic, all-out team vs. team scuffle to conquer the neighborhood!
